_comment: Every Minecraft version the mods are built for. CI reads this to drive both
the pull-request build matrix and the release, so adding a version is one
Fabric up to 1.21.x builds in the fabric module, with Yarn names. From 26.1
Minecraft ships with its own names, so there is no Yarn: those builds use the
fabric26 module, which shares its adapter (vanilla/src/mc26) with NeoForge.
Adding a version is not always free: the mod loaders compile against
Minecraft's own classes, so a new series can break the adapter. If it does,
add a source directory for that series (fabric/src/mc<series>,
neoforge/src/mc<series>, or vanilla/src/mc<series> for both loaders on 26.x
and later) and CI will tell you immediately.
